verification_candidates.claim_text: Finasteride lowers serum DHT levels by about 60 percent.
verification_candidates.evidence_quote: your DHT levels in the serum go down about 60 percent
verification_candidates.rationale: The specific magnitude of DHT reduction from finasteride is a checkable pharmacological fact.

verification_candidates.claim_text: About 90 percent of men taking finasteride see a positive result, with roughly two-thirds experiencing regrowth and five out of six no longer losing hair long-term.
verification_candidates.evidence_quote: two out of three are get some regrowth and five out of six are going to basically stop losing hair for the long run
verification_candidates.rationale: These specific success-rate statistics for finasteride are checkable against clinical trial data.

verification_candidates.claim_text: Lowering DHT with finasteride causes decreased libido and difficulty maintaining an erection in about 2 percent of patients.
verification_candidates.evidence_quote: lowering the DHT has an effect on the sexual functioning in men in 2 percent of patients
verification_candidates.rationale: The specific 2 percent incidence rate for sexual side effects is a checkable clinical statistic.

verification_candidates.claim_text: 98 percent of people taking finasteride report no side effects.
verification_candidates.evidence_quote: 98 percent of folks have no reported side effects
verification_candidates.rationale: This side-effect incidence figure is checkable against clinical trial and prescribing data.

verification_candidates.claim_text: Finasteride clears out of the body within about a week of stopping it.
verification_candidates.evidence_quote: the medication is going to be out of your system in a week
verification_candidates.rationale: The drug's clearance time is a specific, checkable pharmacokinetic claim.

verification_candidates.claim_text: Stopping finasteride allows sexual side effects to resolve fairly quickly.
verification_candidates.evidence_quote: theoretically, you should be able to rebound from that pretty quickly
verification_candidates.rationale: Whether side effects reliably reverse quickly after stopping is a checkable safety claim.

verification_candidates.claim_text: Topical finasteride combined with topical minoxidil works almost as well as oral finasteride while virtually eliminating the risk of systemic side effects.
verification_candidates.evidence_quote: which works almost in my opinion, almost as good as the oral version
verification_candidates.rationale: The comparative efficacy and safety of topical versus oral finasteride is a checkable clinical claim.

verification_candidates.claim_text: PRP hair treatments last about a year before needing to be repeated.
verification_candidates.evidence_quote: We can do PRP treatments, which in my practice last about a year or so.
verification_candidates.rationale: The duration of PRP treatment effect is a checkable clinical claim, here based on personal practice experience rather than data.

verification_candidates.claim_text: Minoxidil works as a direct stimulator of hair follicles.
verification_candidates.rationale: Minoxidil's mechanism of action as a direct follicle stimulant (versus DHT-blocking) is a checkable pharmacological claim.
